brief:
**BLUF:** Bluefield WV police continue searching for Hallie Graham, wanted on first-degree attempted murder and related charges from an Oct. 3 saloon incident; she is considered armed and dangerous. Grants Supermarket in Richlands will close after nearly 25 years, with the final day this Saturday. A planned land-based steelhead trout farm on the Russell-Tazewell line remains on pause due to tariffs and fuel costs, while millions in state grants support other Southwest Virginia development projects and a Mercer County sailor’s remains will be buried with honors Thursday in Hawaii.[[1]](https://www.wvva.com/2026/10/05/grants-supermarket-richlands-closing-after-25-years/)

## LAW ENFORCEMENT AND COURTS
Bluefield WV Police are still seeking Hallie Graham in connection with a shooting incident at Wild Riders Saloon early Saturday morning, Oct. 3. She faces active warrants for first-degree attempted murder, three counts of wanton endangerment, and malicious assault. Graham is considered armed and dangerous; the public is advised not to approach her. Information should be reported to Bluefield PD at (304) 327-6101 (option 1) or 911. Patrolman P.S. Mullins is the investigator. The victim was shot multiple times but is expected to recover.[[2]](https://www.wvva.com/2026/10/04/woman-wanted-attempted-murder-following-alleged-saturday-saloon-incident/)

Nothing else reported in the last 24 hours from Tazewell County Sheriff’s Office, Virginia State Police, Richlands/Tazewell/Bluefield VA police, Mercer County Sheriff, or WV State Police.

## FIRE, EMS AND RESCUE
Nothing reported in the last 24 hours.

## HAZARDS, WEATHER AND ROADS
NWS alerts: none active. No flooding, winter weather, burn bans, power outages, water notices, or major road closures reported on US-19, US-460, US-52, Route 16, Route 67, or I-77 affecting the core area.

## GOVERNMENT AND POLITICS
Virginia Gov. Abigail Spanberger announced $22.7 million in Community Development Block Grants for 17 statewide projects, including several in Southwest Virginia counties and towns (Wise, Lee, Pennington Gap, Honaker). The grants target housing, downtown revitalization, and infrastructure.[[3]](https://www.wjhl.com/news/local/millions-in-grants-awarded-to-southwest-virginia-communities-for-development/)

## OTHER LOCAL
Grants Supermarket at 2960 Clinch St. in Richlands will close after nearly 25 years. The decision follows the impending lease expiration and rising operating costs, including average monthly utility bills exceeding $25,000 over the past two years. The store thanked the community and employees; the last day of business is Saturday, Oct. 10.[[1]](https://www.wvva.com/2026/10/05/grants-supermarket-richlands-closing-after-25-years/)

Pure Salmon’s planned land-based steelhead trout farm on a 200-acre site straddling the Russell-Tazewell county line is on pause. Site clearing and an access road are complete; buildings are the next phase. Del. Will Morefield (R-Tazewell) cited federal tariffs and fuel prices as factors making resumption too costly at present. The project had aimed to employ more than 200 workers.[[4]](https://www.theroanokestar.com/news/pure-salmon-halts-work-on-planned-russell-tazewell-fish-farm/)

Remains of U.S. Navy Fireman 1st Class Howard Lucas Adkins, a Mercer County native from the Goodwill/Nemours area raised in a coal camp, will be laid to rest with full military honors on Thursday, Oct. 8, at the National Memorial Cemetery of the Pacific in Honolulu. Adkins, who turned 20 four days before his death aboard the USS California during the Dec. 7, 1941, Pearl Harbor attack, was identified in 2025 via DNA. Family members plan to attend.[[5]](https://www.wvgazettemail.com/news/remains-of-mercer-county-sailor-killed-in-pearl-harbor-attack-to-be-laid-to-rest/article_2e2d9b9c-dc91-4bf9-83b6-ea7a66faee00.html)

## WATCH -- NEXT 48 HOURS
- Thursday, Oct. 8: Burial ceremony for Howard Lucas Adkins in Hawaii.
- Saturday, Oct. 10: Final day of business at Grants Supermarket in Richlands.
- Ongoing: Bluefield PD search for Hallie Graham; fish farm project status.
